subject: design/workbench-ui-v1
statement: The entry is a **documented node invocation** of the server module in the managed footprint — no Go launcher, no shim (design-brainstorm:workbench-ui-tech-design#D-2): nothing about the entry is shell-specific, so the bash burden-of-proof fails and the invocation line itself is the launcher. Arguments parse fail-closed: any flag-like positional or unknown flag is a usage refusal before any action (incident I3's lesson, applied from birth). This makes the feature's every line Node — the repo's language policy therefore needs its operator-authored carve-out **before the implementation merges** (the PRD's named dependency): proposed wording for the operator — *"Human access/review surfaces (the reading room UI; the vendored review runtime it sits beside) are Node.js by operator ruling — a scoped carve-out; every other executable artifact stays Go."* This design does not edit the policy; the carve-out is the operator's edit riding the implementation change.
